About ELIT DENT · 2014

Dentistry built on planning, not routine

10+ years in practice
6 specialists
3 languages spoken
12 treatment areas

Our philosophy

We believe good dentistry starts before any instrument touches a tooth — with a clear diagnosis and a plan you actually understand.

Our approach to patients

Every visit begins with listening. We explain findings in plain language, in the language you're most comfortable in, and never treat before you've agreed on the plan.

Digital dentistry

3D imaging, intraoral scanning, and microscope-assisted treatment let us plan precisely and show you what to expect before we start.

Our team

A focused group of specialists — implantology, orthodontics, aesthetic dentistry, general and family care — working from one shared standard of care.

The clinic

A calm, unhurried environment designed around patient comfort, from the waiting area to the treatment room.

Technology

See our full technology page for the diagnostic and treatment tools behind every plan.

Your experience

From your first message to your follow-up visit, one team stays with you through the whole process.

Have a question before booking?

Reach out on WhatsApp or by phone — we're happy to answer before you commit to anything.
